name: 27591 · Wendell, NC
findings: ZIP 27591 (Wendell) has 56 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27591 (Wendell) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 27591 (Wendell) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
